{{Quote|I ain't gonna let you build one of these fires, you know, unless you build it in the fireplace|[[Noa Briqualon]]|<ref name="BFE">''[[Ewoks: The Battle for Endor]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Kashyyykian_fireplace.jpg|thumb|150px|A rustic kashyyykian fireplace]]
A '''fireplace''' or '''fireside''' was a place where [[Fire/Legends|fire]] was made and contained, usually for cooking and heating purposes.<ref name="BFE" /> [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] art was often placed above fireplaces, as was noted by linguist [[Ebenn Q3 Baobab/Legends|Ebenn Q3 Baobab]] in a supplement, published in the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]], to his [[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide|travel guide]].<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|51|life/13411_1.html|Today's Traveler - The Art of Dealing with Snivvians}}</ref>
